Good afternoon {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for registering for tonight’s information session. This session will be covering the [Masters without Arizona teacher certification programs], including complete program details and admissions information.

I look forward to having you join the session. If you have any questions or concerns please feel free to contact me!
Kindest regards,
